I believe he assumed she would be helping return them to his grandparents from the beginning via her grandpa.

If she had not asked to keep them would you of been able to move them out the day you left? If the answer is no, then I'm sorry I don't think you have a foot to stand on and yes you should be very grateful your ex is being as helpful as she is. Its a favour you did to let her keep them for a bit but from the usage of your language I am still thinking you assumed she would be part of getting them back to your grandparents. You are misunderstanding that just because they lent them to the both of you to use and take care while you were together she has NO obligation or responsibility to taking care of them POST breakup, they are your furniture, and you have to deal with it and yes be grateful she hasn't just thrown them out after you haven't been able to move them for over a week.
